data.summary: Meridian Bank and Nimbus Labs agreed to launch a pilot of the Nimbus Ledger Sync for UPI reconciliation by November 30, 2026. The meeting established project scope, security compliance requirements, and concrete delivery timelines for sandboxes, mapping documents, and testing data.
decisions: Pilot go-live date is set for Monday 30 November 2026.
Phase one is limited to UPI reconciliation only, with NEFT and IMPS deferred to phase two.

action_items.title: I will send you our standard mutual NDA.
Set up the sandbox environment and send API credentials
I will set up the sandbox environment and send API credentials to Vikram's team by Friday 6 November.
Give the IP ranges we need allowlisted
my team will give you the IP ranges we need allowlisted for the UPI feed. I will send those by Tuesday 10 November.
Write a mapping document for Meridian and Nimbus fields
I will write a mapping document that says which Meridian field feeds which Nimbus field. I can have that to you by Monday 16 November.
Nominate two analysts for user acceptance testing
I will nominate two analysts from my team for user acceptance testing. I will send you their names by Friday 13 November.
Arjun, our intern, is not here today, but he will prepare anonymised sample transaction files from the layout you gave us. Let's say by Thursday 12 November.

follow_up_email.subject: Meridian Bank x Nimbus Labs: Project Kickoff Follow-up
follow_up_email.body:
Hi Neha,

Thank you for a productive kickoff meeting today. As discussed, our go-live date for the UPI reconciliation pilot is set for November 30, 2026.

We have several action items in progress, including sending the mutual NDA, setting up the sandbox environment, preparing the field mapping document, and generating anonymized sample transaction data. Please let us know if you need anything further from our side.

Best regards,
Nimbus Labs Team
